summary: American Honda Receivables LLC, as depositor for Honda Auto Receivables 2026-4 Owner Trust, filed an 8-K under Items 8.01/9.01 disclosing the issuance of $2.11 billion aggregate principal of Class A-1 through A-4 asset-backed notes: A-1 $528.0M, A-2a $416.8M, A-2b $315.8M, A-3 $732.6M and A-4 $112.07M, per a prospectus dated November 3, 2026. American Honda Finance will initially retain at least 5% of each class, satisfying risk-retention rules. Mayer Brown opinions cover legality and tax matters. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation; no deal terms or board recommendation apply.
